description: This file contains implementations of debugging and logging APIs for RDK, including functions to dump logs, initialize debug support, and output raw debug messages.

methods.name: void TouchFile(const char * pszFile)
methods.description: Creates or resets a file specified by filename; used internally to indicate logging activity.

methods.name: void rdk_dbgDumpLog(const char * path)
methods.description: Dumps current log configuration settings for analysis and creates a temp file as a marker.

methods.name: void rdk_dbgInit()
methods.description: Initializes the debug support system; ensures one-time setup per boot cycle.

methods.name: void rdk_dbg_MsgRaw(rdk_LogLevel level,const char * module,const char * format,...)
methods.description: Outputs a raw debug message with variable arguments, respecting the debug level and module.

methods.name: void rdk_dbg_MsgRaw1(rdk_LogLevel level,const char * module,const char * format,va_list args)
methods.description: Outputs a debug message from a va_list, used internally within the debugging framework.

ctags.name: rdk_dbg_MsgRaw1
ctags.signature: (rdk_LogLevel level,const char * module,const char * format,va_list args)
